headline: Gaitanski and Mavrodiev Cleared in Bulgarian Development Bank Loan Case
summary: The Sofia City Prosecutor's Office dropped the case against businessman Rumen Gaitanski, former Bulgarian Development Bank director Stoyan Mavrodiev and lawyer Ivan Georgiev. Prosecutors concluded the 2019 loan was granted in line with established rules.
why: The Bulgarian Development Bank is a state-owned lender, and decisions on its large loans matter to investors assessing governance and legal risk in Bulgaria's financial sector.
